verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a hosted ML platform, but the evidence pack never documents exporting a user's data (predictions, fine-tunes, weights, logs) in open formats. Cog being open-source is about packaging and deploying custom models onto Replicate, not about exporting account data to leave, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
